sourceText: Suggested process targets: receipt immediately digitally or within two working days with assistance; routing within seven calendar days; ordinary response within 21 calendar days unless governing law specifies otherwise; systemic admission decision within 30 days; hearing/decision normally within 60/90 days of admission. These are design targets. Applicable law and urgent safety procedures take precedence.
caveat: These are design targets. Applicable law and urgent safety procedures take precedence.

targets.description: Receipt issued immediately for digital filings
Receipt issued within two working days when filing is assisted, offline, by telephone or by post
Verified lead office, co-owners, applicable rules and response date set within seven calendar days
Reasoned response within 21 calendar days unless governing law specifies otherwise
Hearing normally within 60 days of admission
Decision normally within 90 days of admission

existingLawReference.text: DARPG’s August 2024 grievance guidelines generally use a 21-day framework with interim explanations where additional time is needed. RTI ordinarily has a 30-day response rule and a 48-hour life-or-liberty information provision, subject to the Act. Neither is a universal guarantee of a public hearing or policy change. \[Sources 1–3\]
existingLawReference.note: Existing statutory and administrative timelines are quoted from the pack's sources, not asserted as universal guarantees.
